relationship: Eligible vehicles × work due × dealer capture × net contribution per work unit
rival: Less work due can mimic defection
missing_identifying_inputs: Model/age/km/program, due jobs, completed jobs, labor costs
interpretive_boundary: Same visits can contain different work

relationship: Net parts revenue minus attributable direct parts cost
rival: Parts in a service package may already be in another total
missing_identifying_inputs: SKU/quantity/payer/discount/cost and linkage to work order
interpretive_boundary: Do not count attached parts as another independent customer visit

relationship: Repair demand × capture × realized repair contribution
rival: Collision demand and insurer routing differ from scheduled service cadence
missing_identifying_inputs: Repair scope, authorization, parts/labor, insurer terms, downtime
interpretive_boundary: Lower engine-maintenance needs do not identify body-repair demand

relationship: Holding completed work, price and direct cost fixed: incremental transaction GP=0
rival: A channel move is miscounted as new work
interpretive_boundary: Cost saving or genuinely induced demand is a separate mechanism

relationship: Same work with different payer can change realized price, denial risk or collection time
rival: Changing payer alone is credited as an added job
interpretive_boundary: Zero customer cash does not imply zero dealer GP

relationship: Covered program events versus later customer-paid work
rival: Cohort aging or benefit expiry is mistaken for defection
interpretive_boundary: Maximum years are not actual on-time event count

rival: Margin percentage or payer mix shifts while job count is unchanged
missing_identifying_inputs: Matched scope and period, net receipts and direct cost
interpretive_boundary: An exact bridge is not causal attribution

relationship: Additional retained contribution less displaced existing contribution
rival: A customer would have used another Auto2000 branch/offer anyway
missing_identifying_inputs: Dealer-wide outcomes and feasible alternative path
interpretive_boundary: Branch/app credit is not necessarily company incrementality

relationship: Acceptable incremental contribution > displaced alternative contribution + added capacity cost
rival: Positive stand-alone job GP is assumed enough
missing_identifying_inputs: Real duration, relevant bottleneck and next-best feasible work
interpretive_boundary: No job-hour margins or capacity measured here

relationship: Incremental operating profit = incremental GP − incremental operating expenses
rival: Revenue or GP is presented as net business benefit
missing_identifying_inputs: Real incremental staffing, partner, marketing and running costs
interpretive_boundary: Classify depreciation consistently; do not subtract capex twice

relationship: Track receipts, costs, investment, guarantee settlement and recoveries by period
rival: A future liability or delayed recovery disappears from a short horizon
missing_identifying_inputs: Cohort timelines, receivable terms and actual obligations
interpretive_boundary: The2026–2028investment cap is not a proof of later obligation limits

relationship: Permitted condition evidence may change appraisal confidence or executable offer
rival: Digital certificate already exists and adds no valuation information
missing_identifying_inputs: Appraiser acceptance, matched offers, agreed data access
interpretive_boundary: Certificate retrieval is not price protection or funded risk transfer

relationship: Dealer residual = promised shortfall − eligible recoveries
rival: Per-unit/aggregate insurer limits are called complete protection
missing_identifying_inputs: Signed promise, actual coverage, valuation and aggregate rules
